title: JumpMace
description: Advanced Mace cooldown system with aerial chaining mechanics.
body:
# **JumpMace**

## Features

- Cooldown on landing not hit!
- Fully configurable mace cooldown
- Slime block addon
- Max chain setting
- Easy admin commands
- Fully configurable

## Config


```
enabled: true

cooldown:
  seconds: 5

chain:
  max-hit-chain: 0 # 0 = infinite

blocks:
  water-counts-as-ground: true
  ignore-slime-block: true
```
